salient_findings: Soft tissue mass on the right flank
Overlying pinpoint vessels and branching telangiectasia
key_facts: The patient is an adolescent girl
The condition has been present since infancy
The mass is located on the right flank
The mass is soft and exophytic
The mass has overlying pinpoint vessels and branching telangiectasia

The mass caused concern for appearance and fullness
The lesion is composed of mature adipose and fibrous tissues

shortlist.label: Nevus lipomatosus
shortlist.why_kept: matches the clinical description of a soft, exophytic mass with overlying vessels and telangiectasia, and is composed of mature adipose tissue

shortlist.label: Lipoma
shortlist.why_kept: is a common benign tumor composed of mature adipose tissue, consistent with the histological findings

shortlist.label: Fibrolipoma
shortlist.why_kept: is a type of lipoma that contains both adipose and fibrous tissue, matching the histological description

shortlist.label: Lipoblastoma
shortlist.why_kept: is a rare tumor that can present as a soft tissue mass in infancy, consistent with the patient's age and presentation

shortlist.label: Fibrous hamartoma of infancy
shortlist.why_kept: is a benign tumor that can present as a soft tissue mass in infancy, with a mix of fibrous and adipose tissue, consistent with the clinical and histological findings
